_comment: cooldown and castTime are in simulation seconds. Every action but feed works on the selected grid cell. Requirement: check = matter | placed | stat | unlocked | epoch | host, filtered by item or category, condition = gt | gte | lt | lte | eq. revealRequirements unlock an action for good once met (tech tree), retireRequirements retire it for good, and requirements are checked every time. 'places' makes a seeding action: it creates that overdensity in the selected cell or deepens the one there. Any other action with a lootTable rolls it into the selected cell.

actions.name: perturb
actions.label: Perturb
actions.tooltip: Stretch a quantum fluctuation across the selected cell. It seeds a ripple (an overdensity) there, or deepens the one already there. The energy comes out of the host black hole.

actions.name: feed
actions.label: Feed the Horizon
actions.tooltip: Pour matter from the facility across the event horizon. The host black hole regains mass, and the heavier it is, the slower it evaporates.

actions.name: craft
actions.label: Build
actions.tooltip: Build the chosen recipe in the selected cell, paying with matter from cells within reach of it.

actions.name: use
actions.label: Open
actions.tooltip: Collapse the cache in the selected cell, or in the enclosure there. Its contents land in that cell.

actions.name: dismantle
actions.label: Dismantle
actions.tooltip: Take apart what's in the selected cell and return what it cost to the cell. An enclosure comes apart a layer at a time: its source, then its cache, then the enclosure.
